category_title: Latino/a students with externalizing behaviors who retaliate physically to racial microaggressions
scenario_title: Public academic task refusal due to fear of humiliation
minimal_context: The student is asked to solve a problem on the chalkboard in front of the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Student E, please come up to the chalkboard and write out your answer for the next problem.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for you to participate.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do it on the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to show your work to the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said no! I'm not doing it on the board in front of everyone just so I can get embarrassed.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Student E, please come up to the chalkboard and write out your answer for the next problem.

STUDENT: I'm not going up there.

TUTOR: It is time for you to participate.

STUDENT: I don't want to do it on the board.

TUTOR: You need to show your work to the class.

STUDENT: I said no! I'm not doing it on the board in front of everyone just so I can get embarrassed.

task.content: Refusing to perform academic tasks on the chalkboard in front of the class

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: refused to do work on the board

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: kept her from participating in class
